notes: #3’s date field reads “1681, 1689”: Valvasor’s Ljubljana view carries a 1681 dedication and was printed in Die Ehre dess Hertzogthums Crain (1689), hence the range. #1 and #2 are details of Valvasor views without the castle. #5 is a colored copy of the same composition as #7 (Sandmann, dated 1849, very high resolution but foxed); if the reviewer wants that firmer date, #7 can replace #5 with y 1849. #6 (Fish Square in winter, Künl 1847, color) is a fine landmark alternative but portrait. #10 (Chapuy 1856) and #8 are 39 years apart, just short of the two-view rule. #16 (1967, color) is a brochure spread with the fold through the middle. #4 shows a Sava bridge outside the town.
